notes: Said rabi crop not yet sold, prices low at market yard. Became defensive when I mentioned penalty charges.
Came with group leader Narsimha. Paid 3 EMIs after selling paddy at Jangaon market yard. Wife Lakshmi keeps the cash and decides payments, she was cooperative.
Said all money spent on seeds and fertiliser for kharif sowing. Promised to pay by 20 July. Lakshmi was not at home.
Ramesh broke the 20 July promise. Lakshmi paid one EMI from her SHG savings, asked us to come when Ramesh is at home in the evening.
Says he will clear everything after kharif harvest in November. Group leader Narsimha says Ramesh always pays after harvest but not before.
Paid but was unhappy we came during customer hours. Asked us to message on WhatsApp instead of visiting the shop.
Paid via UPI 2 days after the WhatsApp reminder. School admission fees for two children in June, but still paid.
Dasara festival orders coming in, she is waiting for customer payments for blouse stitching orders. Promised UPI payment by 30 Sept.
Said auto needed engine repair, Rs 8,000 spent. Promised by 10 May.
Broke 10 May promise. Phone switched off. Not found at Chandrayangutta auto stand on Thursday afternoon.
Found him at home at 8 AM on Sunday before he left for the day. Paid one EMI in cash. Mother was present and told him to pay.
Broke 20 June promise. Phone off again. Third broken promise.
Sunday morning home visit worked again. Mother insists he pays. He earns more on weekends from Charminar tourist trips. Suggested daily savings of Rs 200 towards EMI, he agreed to try.
Paid at SHG weekly meeting. Sells about 12 litres milk per day to Vijaya dairy collection centre, paid every 15 days.
One buffalo died of illness in early July, no insurance claim filed. Milk income halved. Very upset, crying. Asked if loan can be restructured.
Agreed to pay Rs 1,500 every dairy payment cycle (15 days) instead of full EMI. Paid first instalment on the spot. SHG leader Saroja supports this plan. Honest borrower, not wilful default.
Paid Rs 1,500 on dairy payment day as agreed. Restructuring request forwarded to branch manager, pending.
Customers were present in the store. He got angry and shouted that we were insulting him in front of the neighbourhood. Refused to talk.
Sent a formal letter inviting him to the branch. He came, spoke calmly with branch manager, paid 2 EMIs. Says wholesale supplier gives him 30 days credit, cash is tight around 20th each month.
Asked if EMI date can be moved from 20th to 5th of the month, when his supplier credit cycle resets. Promised to pay September EMI by 5 October.
